title: The campus launcher
caption: Opened from the desktop or Start Menu shortcut. It runs the server that the gate terminals connect to, so leave this window open.

redact.label: Log details hidden in this picture

marks.label: Server status and address
marks.desc: RUNNING or STOPPED, and the address guards and CDSO staff open in their browsers.

marks.label: Health
marks.desc: Database connection, cameras online, and whether live updates are working.

marks.label: Start / Stop server
marks.desc: Starts or stops the system. Stopping it disconnects every gate terminal and camera.

marks.label: Open pages
marks.desc: Guard terminal opens the gate sign-in page, Admin login opens the CDSO login, and Copy URL copies the address.

marks.label: Updates
marks.desc: Checks for a newer version every few minutes. When one is found, click "Update and restart" at a quiet moment: restarting drops the camera feeds briefly.

marks.label: Settings
marks.desc: Port, start the server when this window opens, kiosk mode (full screen), and which page opens automatically.

marks.label: Save settings / Credentials
marks.desc: Save your changes. Credentials holds the shared database URL and secret key; it is only needed once per computer.

marks.label: Activity
marks.desc: Live messages from the server. Log files opens the saved logs; Clear empties this view. Useful when reporting a problem.

marks.label: Install location and version
marks.desc: Where the application lives and which version (branch and commit) is running.
